gbm_population_evidence.quote: Previously confirmed (histologically or cytologically) high grade glioma that is clinically or radiographically suspected to be relapsed, refractory, or recurrent

candidate_evidence.quote: CLR 131 (other names: iopofosine I 131): CLR 131 will be administered IV (intravenously) at a dose based on patients' BSA

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Novel Targeted Radiotherapy in Pediatric Patients With Inoperable Relapsed or Refractory HGG

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: Determine the tumor uptake of CLR 131 and utility of SPECT/CT as a potential diagnostic for response.
Image data will be converted to activity per cubic centimeters using a sensitivity measurement made using a point source in air.

agents.drug_class_hint: iodine-131 phospholipid ether radioconjugate (iopofosine I-131, CLR 131); targeted radiotherapeutic, isotope 131I

coder_notes: High-grade glioma only; glioblastoma is not named anywhere in the record, so S5 = high_grade_glioma_unspecified (exclusion). Ages 10-25 (CHILD, ADULT). tumour_pk_planned coded yes because SPECT/CT quantifies tumour uptake of the radiopharmaceutical (activity per cubic centimetre); adjudicator may consider imaging uptake not equivalent to tissue PK.
